import re

def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    pattern = r"- (\w+) paid \$(\d+) for \"([^\"]+)\". Owed equally by (.+)\."
    for line in content.splitlines():
        m = re.match(pattern, line.strip())
        if m:
            payer = m.group(1)
            amount = float(m.group(2))
            desc = m.group(3)
            debtors_str = m.group(4)
            # Replace " and " with ", " then split
            debtors = [d.strip() for d in debtors_str.replace(" and ", ", ").split(",")]
            expenses.append({
                'payer': payer,
                'amount': amount,
                'description': desc,
                'debtors': debtors
            })
    return expenses
